rules: R1 types: int, unsigned int and long long become long; unsigned wrap-around is replaced by the trap-unless-proved overflow semantics of the emitter (the content values are not a proof goal)

R2 sizes: nondeterministic or constant array dimensions become long parameters; the upstream entry guard becomes REQUIRES (SIZE > 1 && SIZE < MAX stays literal, MAX spelled 100000L for the portable literal range); a constant dimension gets 0 <= v, or 0 < v where it divides in the capacity contract or where the task reads index 0 unconditionally

R3 arrays: a VLA or safe_malloc array becomes `long a[], long a_len` with the capacity conjunct n <= a_len; a 2-D array A[m][n] becomes a flat array indexed A[i * n + j] with m <= A_len / n; 3-D A[(i*n + j)*p + k] with m <= A_len / p / n; 4-D likewise

R4 nondeterminism: loops that only fill arrays with nondeterministic values are dropped and the array becomes an input parameter (const when never written); a per-iteration nondeterministic read (ReadFromPort) becomes a read of an input array `port` at the index of the store it feeds; a nondeterministic or uninitialized scalar becomes a parameter

R5 property: the final loop asserting a universally quantified content property is dropped (not expressible in the subset); the proof goals are the bounds of every remaining access and the overflow of the index arithmetic; the function returns the last loop counter (or the computed scalar for max/min); locals used only by the dropped loop are dropped

R6 control: for loops become while loops with explicit i = i + 1 / i = i - 1; `SIZE % k == 0` assumptions and the early `return 1` are dropped (they constrain only the content property); `SIZE / k` bounds stay literal

R7 B0 invariant: for every loop, the conjunction of the counter's bounds at the loop head (initial value and exit bound: lo <= i && i <= hi for ascending, lo - 1 <= i && i <= hi for descending), nothing else
R8 identifiers: upstream names are kept (CELLCOUNT, volArray, MINVAL, A, B, C, m, n, p, q, s); no SEPARATED is added
selection: every .c task of c/array-tiling and c/array-multidimensional at the recorded commit whose unreach-call expected verdict is true, in lexicographic order of the file name; a task is excluded only for a construct outside the pfc subset (listed in EXCLUDED) or because the frozen admit() rejects the mechanical B0 (recorded per task); the rules were fixed on 2026-11-10 before any proposer, Houdini or differential run read the set
